# Getting Help & Support

If you need help using or deploying TTS_MultiModel, here are the recommended channels:

- Discussions: https://github.com/ReSerendipity/TTS_MultiModel/discussions — best place for general questions, how-tos, and community help.
- Issues: For reproducible bugs and feature requests, open an Issue and choose the appropriate template (bug report / feature request).
- Security: For security-sensitive reports, see SECURITY.md (do NOT open a public issue for security vulnerabilities).

Community hours / response
- We aim to respond to Discussions and Issues within a few business days. For urgent security reports, see SECURITY.md.

How to report effectively
- Provide environment details (OS, Python version, GPU), steps to reproduce, and relevant logs (logs/app.log).

Thank you for participating — the community keeps this project healthy.
